title: Voxi Eager Pipeline Injection-Safety Tuning
description: Modifier-release race guard (issue 101) and post-stop delivery drain (issue 115) tuning for internal/eager.

energy_gate.description: Energy gate thresholds for audio segmentation (issue 215).

threshold_rms.description: Per-frame RMS energy threshold to trigger speech detection.

min_mean_rms.description: Minimum average RMS across a candidate segment to be accepted as speech.

min_voiced_frames.description: Minimum number of voiced frames (>= threshold_rms) across the segment.

min_voiced_run_frames.description: Minimum consecutive voiced frames required to accept a segment.

bluetooth_mic.description: Bluetooth headset dictation (issue 210): digital gain for Bluetooth default sources and the keep-awake drop-in managed by `voxi mic headset`.

device_api.description: PipeWire device.api of a Bluetooth card (BlueZ).

node_prefix.description: Node-name prefix of a Bluetooth input node.

gain_max.description: Ceiling for the user override bluetooth_mic_gain (config.yaml); equals the gain_factor maximum.

gain_factor.description: Linear sample gain applied to PCM when the default source is Bluetooth. The system volume is never changed.

node_matches.description: WirePlumber node.name matches the keep-awake drop-in applies to.

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Idle suspend timeout for the matched nodes; 0 keeps the headset mic link awake.

autoswitch_setting.description: WirePlumber setting name that controls automatic switching to headset (HFP) profile.

dropin_name.description: Drop-in file name under the WirePlumber config directory.

dropin_marker.description: The exact first line of a drop-in that marks it as voxi-owned.

a2dp_profile.description: Card profile of a Bluetooth headset without a mic (A2DP); pinned away from when keep-awake is enabled.

headset_profile.description: Card profile that provides the headset mic (HFP) to pin the card to.

restore_record_prefix.description: Prefix of the drop-in line that records autoswitch was turned off by voxi (value true).

drain.description: Post-stop delivery drain bounds. The delivery policy itself is 'type unless a newer session has started'; these are only bounds around it.

delivery_deadline_ms.description: Absolute safety net in milliseconds after a stop, beyond which an abandoned generation stops typing. Must stay well above the per-job transcription timeout so it never drops real speech.

injection_timeout_ms.description: Per-delivery keystroke injection budget in milliseconds. Must exceed the 5000ms physical-modifier-release wait inside typing.TypeTextObserved.

modifier_gate.description: Buffering/staleness tuning for the modifier-release typing race.

timeout_ms.description: Staleness window in milliseconds: a gating-modifier press older than this is ignored for buffering purposes.

start_grace_ms.description: Modifier presses observed within this many milliseconds of a recording session starting are ignored, since the start hotkey itself is typically a gating-modifier press.

notify_delay_ms.description: Delay before playing the typing-paused notification after entering buffering; canceled if the session flushes before this elapses.

mic_check.description: Mic self-check run alongside each recording (issue 177).

timeout_ms.description: Budget in milliseconds for the whole check-and-repair run.

dead_signal_ms.description: How long the first audio may be all-zero before the mic counts as dead.

settle_ms.description: How long to wait for WirePlumber to apply a profile or default change.
